clips.title: The story
paras: In the Charred Vale, spirits of flame and stone rage after the Venture Company’s destruction. Fire and heavy machinery laid waste to the basin, and the freed elementals overran it. Alliance champions are asked to quell them so the wounded land may heal under Elune’s grace.

The Charred Vale was once a lush haven in Stonetalon. The Venture Company’s greed turned it to ash as goblins drove to log the forest and strip its resources. They used incendiary devices and heavy machinery, setting the canopy ablaze. Their actions destroyed the trees and shattered the fragile elemental balance beneath the earth.

The Venture Company’s work stirred ancient spirits of fire, stone, and fury from the depths. The enraged elementals turned on the goblins, drove them back, and claimed the smoldering crater. Kaela Shadowspear says nature cannot begin to recover while these chaotic elementals remain.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm unsure what the Venture Co. Did to the Vale, but it's obvious they were overpowered by the creatures there.
They set the forest aflame, and used their inventions of destruction to decimate as much of the Vale as possible.
But in their ignorance they also released something else: burning spirits, elementals of flame, stone and rage.
The land has no chance to see Elune's smile while these creatures roam free.
Bring me their smoldering embers to show you've reduced their numbers.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The first time I saw the Charred Vale I almost wept, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The remains of our enemy... Your strength serves us well, friend. Thank you.
